title: Wind—Play
identity: The composer’s current compositions page identifies Wind-Play (2000) for soprano saxophone and piano, 3:30, premiered 22 August 2001; the composer also rewrote it for alto saxophone. SAMRO’s work archive dates its entry 2001 and describes a five-pulse piano opening motif and a saxophone line derived from suspended piano harmonies; the score upload is still being processed. An independent researcher’s catalogue gives a different duration (2:40), left unresolved.

evidence.claim: SAMRO archive dates Wind-Play 2001; identifies it as written for a young player and describes a five-pulse piano opening motif, with saxophone melody derived from suspended piano harmonies. The score is marked as still being processed, so notation is unavailable.
University of Pretoria bibliography also indexes soprano and alto scores and gives 3:30; the underlying scan is unavailable, so its own level III notation is not interpreted.
evidence.source_name: Karlien Gerber, An Annotated Bibliography of Selected Classical Saxophone Works by South African Composers

evidence.claim: Noa Even’s performer-maintained repertoire page lists Wind-Play (2000), 3:30, soprano or alto saxophone and piano, with an attached video link.

Independent South African Saxophone Catalogue lists Wind-play (2000), soprano saxophone and piano, 2:40, premiered 22 August 2001 by Adriaan Esterhuizen and Clare Loveday. Duration differs from other listings and remains unresolved.
Current composer page identifies Wind-Play (2000) for soprano saxophone and piano, an alto rewrite, 3:30, and the 2001 premiere.

review_focus: Inference from SAMRO’s work note: listen for how the piano’s five-pulse opening gesture relates to the saxophone’s derived, suspended-harmony line. This musical relationship is described by the archive, not verified against notation.
collection_flag: Composer says the work was rewritten for alto. SAMRO describes it as written for a young player; collection fit should be considered by instrument/version and score access.

listening.description: Video linked from Noa Even’s repertoire listing for Wind-Play; link target identified as YouTube but playback not auditioned.

score_links.description: SAMRO archive work page and score listing; archive says upload is still being processed.

gaps: Readable notation and exact soprano/alto edition range remain unavailable.
Duration and composition-year metadata vary among performer, composer, archive and independent catalogue listings; do not treat one timing as a correction.
Linked video was not auditioned, and version/instrument of the video is not verified.
